subject: Audit log ingest credits vs HSM seat — invoicing path for on‑prem setup
messages:
From: Erin Zhao <erin.zhao@medflow.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: MedFlow Procurement <procurement@medflow.co>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit log pricing — ingest vs seats and on‑prem billing question

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Two quick asks from our side as we map budget: 1) we need a clear way to compare 'audit log ingest credits' (per‑GB or per‑million events) vs the HSM seat model you mentioned; 2) for on‑prem/private deployments, will the implementation/onboarding fee be invoiced up front or amortized as a credit over the first 12 months? Our finance team prefers amortization but procurement needs to understand accounting treatment.

Also curious if audit log retention beyond 13 months is an add‑on and how that is priced.

Erin
Head of Platform — MedFlow

---
Attachments: sample-ingest-volumes.csv (provided)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Erin Zhao <erin.zhao@medflow.co>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log pricing — ingest vs seats and on‑prem billing question

Hi Erin —

Great questions. Short answer: we can structure audit log billing two ways (usage credits or committed ingest bundles) and HSM can be priced as seats (per‑region/per‑cluster) or as a managed pass‑through depending on your procurement preference. For on‑prem implementation we offer either: a) one‑time implementation fee invoiced up front, or b) an implementation credit amortized across the first 12 months of recurring invoice. The credit path requires a minimum 12‑month commitment.

I attached a compact CSV with three canonical options and a draft SOW that shows the implementation milestones. Key callouts:
- Audit log ingest credits: priced per GB ingested; can be purchased ad‑hoc or committed at volume tiers with stepped discounts.
- Committed bundles: we provide a monthly invoice credit against usage when you buy a 12‑ or 24‑month ingest commitment.
- HSM seats: priced per logical HSM cluster; discounts available at >3 clusters. Seats are invoiced monthly.
- Retention beyond 13 months: recurring storage add‑on billed per GB/month.

I'll let Jonas and Laura weigh in on typical invoice treatment and whether procurement usually accepts amortized credits for large on‑prem pilots.

— Mina
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Erin Zhao <erin.zhao@medflow.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log pricing — ingest vs seats and on‑prem billing question

Erin, Mina —

From a billing/finance perspective we've been successful with the amortized credit approach when customers need predictable P&L treatment. Practical notes:
- We issue the full implementation invoice at signing and then apply a fixed monthly credit on subsequent invoices (example: $120k implementation = $10k credit x12). This keeps our AR treatment simple while giving customers the benefit they want.
- For procurement that refuses up‑front invoices, we can offer a net‑30 amortized invoice schedule tied to acceptance milestones (two or three milestone triggers).
- The ingest credit model maps cleanly to usage dashboards (we're able to show remaining committed GBs).

I'll also flag that HSM seats often trigger separate license terms; if MedFlow wants HSM per‑region with cross‑region replication we'll need to price replication links as additional seats.

— Jonas (Finance & Pricing)

From: Erin Zhao <erin.zhao@medflow.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: MedFlow Procurement <procurement@medflow.co>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log pricing — ingest vs seats and on‑prem billing question

Thanks Mina/Jonas — this is helpful. A few follow ups from procurement:
- Can you provide an example amortization schedule we can attach to the PO? Preferably line items that show implementation fee and monthly credit.
- For audit log credits, we need clarity on overage pricing and whether unused committed GBs roll forward.
- For HSM seats: confirm whether disaster‑recovery clusters count as billable seats.

Procurement gave me a hard stop on upfront vendor invoices unless there is a signed SOW with milestone‑based acceptance. If you can do milestone invoicing, that will make purchase easier.

Erin

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Erin Zhao <erin.zhao@medflow.co>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log pricing — ingest vs seats and on‑prem billing question

Erin —

Attached is a redlineable SOW and an example invoice amortization schedule (we'll mark it as illustrative). Quick answers:
- Overage for ingest: billed at the next tier rate; unused committed GBs can roll quarter‑to‑quarter (not indefinitely) — typical roll forward window we offer is 90 days.
- DR clusters: yes, they count as billable HSM seats if they are active and holding keys; standby/passive DR can be discounted.
- Milestone invoicing: we can break the implementation invoice into 3 milestones aligned to the SOW (kickoff, integration complete, acceptance), each invoiced on completion and optionally amortized as monthly credits.

Next step: can your procurement share a preferred PO template and desired milestone cadence? If not, we propose: 30% kickoff, 40% integration, 30% acceptance.

— Mina

Attachments: AuditLog_Pricing_Options.csv; OnPrem_SOW_Draft.docx

Erin
